description:
Onsa finds real B2B prospects — actual people with LinkedIn profiles — scored against your ideal-customer profile, and keeps every search as a campaign you can come back to.

Ask for leads in plain language and Onsa's agent runs a live search, returning each person with their title, company, a 1–5 score and the written reasoning behind that score. Every search becomes a campaign, so you can grow it, steer it toward a different segment, or compare it against earlier ones to see which profile actually produced replies.

Onsa carries the outreach side too. It returns what prospects wrote back — the actual text, not just counts — alongside the funnel: invites sent, invites accepted, messages sent, and replies split by sentiment. When a draft reads like a mail-merge, you can pull up the research memo Onsa already wrote about that person and rewrite the message around one specific, checkable fact.

Sending is deliberately hard to do by accident. Queueing a LinkedIn message reaches a real human, so the tool refuses unless the exact draft text and the recipient's name are quoted back to it, it puts a confirmation in front of the person at the keyboard, and each approval is single-use and bound to one recipient and one draft. A client that cannot show a confirmation dialog sends nothing — Onsa returns a link to approve inside the app instead.

Requires an Onsa account. New workspaces start on a free trial with a prospect allowance; when the allowance runs out, every campaign, lead and reply already in the workspace stays readable.

defaultPrompt: List my campaigns, then show the funnel and what people wrote back for the one with the most leads.
Find 5 heads of sales at Series B fintech companies in New York, and tell me the progress while the search runs.
Show me the outreach drafts waiting for approval and rewrite the weakest one around a specific fact about the person.
